entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
entities.description: A substate of 5GMM-DEREGISTERED entered by the UE when the initial registration procedure fails due to missing network response or specific failure circumstances.

entities.name: Initial Registration Procedure
entities.description: The procedure for UE to register with the 5G network.

entities.name: Missing Network Response
entities.description: Condition where the initial registration fails due to no response received from the network.

entities.name: Specific Failure Circumstances
entities.description: Failure conditions described in subclauses 5.5.1.2.4, 5.5.1.2.5, 5.5.1.2.7 and 5.5.1.3.4.

relations.description: Missing network response condition leads to entering the ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION substate.
Specific failure circumstances lead to entering the ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION substate.
Initial registration procedure failure results in transition to ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION state.
